ddl.value: ("deleted_at" is null and nullif(btrim("content"), '') is not null) or ("deleted_at" is not null and "content" is null)
ddl.name: message_content_state_check

ddl.value: ("email_status" = 'sent'::notification_email_status and "emailed_at" is not null and "email_error" is null) or ("email_status" = 'failed'::notification_email_status and "emailed_at" is null and nullif(btrim("email_error"), '') is not null) or ("email_status" in ('not_requested', 'pending') and "emailed_at" is null and "email_error" is null)
ddl.name: notification_email_state_check

ddl.value: ("cover_key" is null and "cover_focal_x" is null and "cover_focal_y" is null) or ("cover_key" is not null and "cover_focal_x" between 0 and 1 and "cover_focal_y" between 0 and 1)
ddl.name: unit_cover_shape_check

ddl.value: "title" is not null or "summary" is not null or "description" is not null or "content" is not null
ddl.name: unit_localization_value_check

ddl.value: ("resolved_at" is null and "resolved_by_profile_id" is null and "resolution" is null) or ("resolved_at" is not null and "resolved_by_profile_id" is not null and nullif(btrim("resolution"), '') is not null)
ddl.name: feedback_resolution_check

ddl.value: not "active" or ("state" = 'ready'::recommendation_snapshot_state and "completed_at" is not null)
ddl.name: recommendation_snapshot_active_ready_check

ddl.value: ("state" = 'building'::recommendation_snapshot_state and "completed_at" is null) or ("state" <> 'building'::recommendation_snapshot_state and "completed_at" is not null)
ddl.name: recommendation_snapshot_completion_check

ddl.value: "impressions" >= 0 and "opens" >= 0 and "dwell_30s" >= 0 and "upvotes" >= 0 and "downvotes" >= 0 and "replies" >= 0 and "favorites" >= 0 and "shares" >= 0 and "high_scores" >= 0 and "active_progress" >= 0 and "completions" >= 0 and "negative_progress" >= 0
ddl.name: recommendation_unit_stat_counts_check

ddl.name: zone_time_range_check
